name: IADDF Path Tracing
aliases: DDF rendering via backward path tracing
IADDF Path Tracing — DDF-based path tracing, backward path tracer
definition: A Monte Carlo rendering method solving the classical rendering equation using the IADDF. It traces rays backwards from the eye to light sources, using the DDF to find surface intersections and the material/lighting fields to compute radiance.
summary: IADDF Path Tracing is a backward Monte Carlo method using differentiable implicit fields for geometry and appearance, distinguishing itself by enabling continuous, analytic surface representation without explicit mesh topology.
